Name: Bench Press
Setup: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar, plant your feet firmly, pull your shoulder blades together and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Execution: Unrack the bar and lower it under control to your mid chest with your elbows at about 45 degrees. Press it back up in a slight arc until your arms are straight, keeping your glutes on the bench and your shoulder blades pinned.

Name: Incline Dumbbell Press
Setup: Set the bench to 30 to 45 degrees, sit back with a dumbbell on each thigh and kick them up to shoulder height with your feet planted and your back against the pad.
Execution: Press the dumbbells up and slightly together until your arms are straight above your upper chest. Lower them slowly until your elbows are just below the bench line and press again without bouncing.

Name: Cable Crossovers
Setup: Set both pulleys high, grab a handle in each hand, step forward into a staggered stance and lean slightly forward with a soft bend in your elbows.
Execution: Sweep your hands down and together in a wide arc until they meet in front of your hips, squeezing your chest. Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest without letting the stack touch down.

Name: Deadlift
Setup: Stand with the bar over your mid foot, hinge down and grip just outside your legs. Drop your hips, lift your chest and pull the slack out of the bar until your back is flat and tight.
Execution: Push the floor away and drag the bar up your legs until your hips and knees lock out together. Hinge back at the hips to lower the bar along the same path and reset before the next rep.

Name: Pull-ups
Setup: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders, arms fully extended, legs slightly forward and your shoulder blades gently pulled down.
Execution: Drive your elbows toward your hips and pull until your chin clears the bar. Lower yourself under control until your arms are fully straight before starting the next rep.

Name: Barbell Rows
Setup: Stand with feet hip width apart, hinge forward until your torso is about 45 degrees to the floor and grip the bar just outside your knees with a flat back.
Execution: Pull the bar toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades. Lower it slowly until your arms are straight, keeping your torso angle the same throughout.

Name: Squats
Setup: Set the bar across your upper back, step back from the rack with your feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly turned out. Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Execution: Sit down and back, pushing your knees out over your toes until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor. Drive through your whole foot to stand up, keeping the bar over your mid foot.

Name: Leg Press
Setup: Sit in the machine with your back and hips flat against the pad and place your feet shoulder width apart in the middle of the platform. Release the safety handles.
Execution: Lower the platform until your knees reach roughly 90 degrees without your hips rolling off the pad. Press through your heels and mid foot to extend your legs without locking your knees hard.

Name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
Setup: Hold the bar at hip height with an overhand grip, stand tall with your feet hip width apart and a slight bend in your knees. Pull your shoulders back and brace your core.
Execution: Push your hips straight back and slide the bar down your thighs until you feel a deep stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your back flat. Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes at the top.

Name: Overhead Press
Setup: Rack the bar at collarbone height, grip just outside your shoulders and stand with your feet hip width apart. Squeeze your glutes and brace your core so you do not lean back.
Execution: Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back and then through once the bar passes your forehead. Lock out overhead with the bar over your mid foot, then lower it back to your collarbone with control.

Name: Lateral Raises
Setup: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides, with a slight bend in your elbows and your core braced.
Execution: Raise your arms out to the sides until they are about shoulder height, leading with your elbows rather than your hands. Pause briefly and lower slowly over two to three seconds without swinging your body.

Name: Barbell Bicep Curl
Setup: Stand holding a barbell with a shoulder width underhand grip, elbows tucked against your sides and your chest up.
Execution: Curl the bar toward your shoulders without moving your elbows forward or leaning back. Squeeze your biceps at the top and lower the bar all the way down under control.

Name: Tricep Pushdown
Setup: Attach a bar or rope to a high pulley, stand close with a slight forward lean and pin your elbows against your sides.
Execution: Push the handle down until your arms are fully straight, squeezing your triceps at the bottom. Let the handle rise slowly until your forearms are just past parallel, keeping your elbows still.

Name: Cable Crunches
Setup: Kneel below a high pulley with a rope held beside your head, hips stacked over your knees and your back in a neutral position.
Execution: Curl your ribcage toward your pelvis by rounding your spine, pulling the rope down with your abs rather than your arms. Hold briefly at the bottom and return slowly to the start.

Name: Plank
Setup: Place your forearms on the floor with your elbows under your shoulders and extend your legs behind you on your toes.
Execution: Hold your body in a straight line from head to heels by squeezing your glutes and bracing your abs. Breathe steadily and stop the set when your hips start to sag or pike.

Name: Chest Press Machine
Setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your mid chest, sit back with your feet flat and your shoulder blades against the pad.
Execution: Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight without shrugging your shoulders. Return slowly until you feel a light stretch across your chest and press again.

Name: Pec Deck / Butterfly
Setup: Adjust the seat so your upper arms are parallel to the floor, sit with your back flat against the pad and rest your forearms or hands on the pads.
Execution: Bring the pads together in front of your chest by squeezing your pecs, keeping a slight bend in your elbows. Open back up slowly until you feel a stretch, but stop before your shoulders roll forward.

Name: Flat Dumbbell Press
Setup: Sit on the end of a flat bench with the dumbbells on your thighs, lie back and kick them up to chest level with your feet planted and shoulder blades squeezed together.
Execution: Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your chest. Lower them slowly until your elbows are slightly below the bench and your chest feels a stretch, then press again.

Name: Decline Dumbbell Press
Setup: Secure your legs on a decline bench and lie back holding the dumbbells at the sides of your lower chest with your palms facing forward.
Execution: Press the dumbbells up and slightly together until your arms are straight. Lower them under control to the sides of your lower chest and keep your wrists stacked over your elbows.

Name: Flat Dumbbell Flyes
Setup: Lie on a flat bench holding the dumbbells above your chest with your palms facing each other and a soft bend in your elbows.
Execution: Open your arms in a wide arc until you feel a deep stretch across your chest, keeping the elbow bend fixed. Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbells back together above you.

Name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes
Setup: Set the bench to a low incline, lie back and hold the dumbbells above your upper chest with your palms facing each other and a soft bend in your elbows.
Execution: Lower the weights out to the sides in a wide arc until your upper chest is stretched. Reverse the motion by squeezing your chest, stopping the dumbbells just above your shoulders.

Name: Incline Bench Press
Setup: Set an incline bench to 30 degrees, lie back with your eyes under the bar, plant your feet and pull your shoulder blades together before gripping slightly wider than your shoulders.
Execution: Lower the bar under control to your upper chest just below the collarbone. Press it back up until your arms are straight, keeping your shoulder blades pinned to the bench.

Name: Decline Bench Press
Setup: Lock your legs under the pads of a decline bench, lie back with your eyes under the bar and grip slightly wider than shoulder width with your shoulder blades pulled together.
Execution: Lower the bar to your lower chest with your elbows at about 45 degrees. Press it back up to lockout and re-rack carefully, since this angle makes unracking awkward.

Name: Seated Machine Row
Setup: Adjust the seat and chest pad so your arms are fully extended when you grip the handles, and sit tall with your chest against the pad.
Execution: Pull the handles back toward your torso by driving your elbows behind you and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Let the weight return slowly until your lats are stretched.

Name: Assisted Pull-ups
Setup: Choose an assistance weight, kneel or stand on the pad and grip the handles slightly wider than your shoulders with your arms extended.
Execution: Pull yourself up until your chin passes the handles by driving your elbows down toward your hips. Lower under control until your arms are straight, using less assistance as you get stronger.

Name: T-Bar Row
Setup: Stand on the platform or straddle the bar, hinge forward with a flat back and grip the handle with your knees slightly bent.
Execution: Row the weight toward your chest by pulling your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades. Lower it slowly until your arms are straight without rounding your lower back.

Name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
Setup: Adjust the thigh pad so your legs are locked in, grab the bar with an overhand grip well wider than your shoulders and sit tall with a slight lean back.
Execution: Pull the bar down to your upper chest by driving your elbows toward your sides. Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight and your lats are fully stretched.

Name: Lat Pulldown (Close Grip)
Setup: Lock your thighs under the pad, hold a close grip handle with your palms facing each other and sit tall with your chest up.
Execution: Pull the handle down to your upper chest, keeping your elbows close to your torso. Control it back up until your arms are fully extended and repeat without swinging.

Name: Lat Pulldown (Reverse Grip)
Setup: Lock your thighs under the pad and grab the bar with an underhand grip about shoulder width apart, sitting tall with your chest up.
Execution: Pull the bar to your upper chest by driving your elbows down and back, feeling your lower lats and biceps work. Return slowly to full arm extension without letting your shoulders shrug up.

Name: Seated Cable Row
Setup: Sit at the cable station with your feet on the platform, knees slightly bent, and grab the handle with your arms extended and your back straight.
Execution: Pull the handle to your lower ribs by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Return slowly until your arms are straight, keeping your torso upright without rocking.

Name: Straight-Arm Cable Pullover
Setup: Stand facing a high pulley, grip the bar or rope with straight arms, hinge slightly forward at the hips and brace your core.
Execution: Keeping your arms nearly straight, sweep the bar down in an arc until it reaches your thighs by squeezing your lats. Let it rise slowly back to eye level without bending your elbows.

Name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
Setup: Place one knee and the same-side hand on a bench, keep your back flat and hold a dumbbell in the other hand with your arm hanging straight down.
Execution: Pull the dumbbell toward your hip by driving your elbow back and up. Lower it slowly until your arm is straight and your lat is stretched, keeping your torso from twisting.

Name: Dumbbell Pullover
Setup: Lie across or along a flat bench with your upper back supported, hold one dumbbell with both hands above your chest and keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Execution: Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until you feel a deep stretch in your lats and chest. Pull it back over your chest by squeezing your lats while keeping your ribs down.

Name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
Setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, hinge forward until your torso is about 45 degrees to the floor and let your arms hang with your back flat and knees soft.
Execution: Row both dumbbells to your hips by pulling your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades together. Lower them slowly without letting your back round or your torso rise.

Name: Leg Extensions
Setup: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the machine pivot, place your shins under the pad and hold the handles with your back against the seat.
Execution: Extend your legs until they are straight and squeeze your quadriceps at the top. Lower the weight slowly over about three seconds without letting the stack crash down.

Name: Seated Leg Curls
Setup: Adjust the machine so your knees line up with the pivot, sit with the pad resting just above your heels and secure the thigh pad over your legs.
Execution: Curl the pad down and back by squeezing your hamstrings until your legs are fully bent. Return slowly until your legs are almost straight, keeping your hips pressed into the seat.

Name: Lying Leg Curls
Setup: Lie face down on the machine with your knees just past the edge of the bench and the pad resting on the back of your lower legs, just above your heels.
Execution: Curl the pad toward your glutes by contracting your hamstrings without lifting your hips off the bench. Lower it slowly until your legs are almost straight.

Name: Hip Abductor / Adductor Machine
Setup: Sit with your back against the pad, set the pads on the outside of your knees for abduction or the inside for adduction and choose a light weight.
Execution: Push your legs apart for abduction or squeeze them together for adduction through a comfortable range. Pause briefly at the end of each rep and return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.

Name: Machine Calf Raises
Setup: Position yourself with your shoulders under the pads and the balls of your feet on the platform edge, with your heels hanging off and your legs straight.
Execution: Press up onto your toes as high as possible and squeeze your calves for a second. Lower your heels slowly until you feel a deep stretch before the next rep.

Name: Cable Kickbacks
Setup: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley, face the machine holding the frame and lean forward slightly with a soft bend in your standing knee.
Execution: Kick your working leg straight back by squeezing your glute, without arching your lower back. Pause at the top and return slowly without letting the weight rest.

Name: Cable Lateral Leg Raises
Setup: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and stand side-on to the machine, holding the frame and keeping your torso tall with the cuff on your far ankle.
Execution: Lift your working leg out and across to the side by squeezing your outer hip and glute. Lower it slowly and keep your toes pointing forward so your hips stay square.

Name: Standing Cable Leg Curls
Setup: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley, face the machine, hold the frame for balance and stand tall on the leg that is not working.
Execution: Curl your heel toward your glute by squeezing your hamstring while keeping your thigh still. Lower slowly until your leg is nearly straight and repeat before switching sides.

Name: Goblet Squats
Setup: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands cupping the top end, feet slightly wider than shoulder width and toes turned out a little.
Execution: Sit straight down between your knees, keeping your chest up and elbows inside your knees at the bottom. Drive through your whole foot to stand and squeeze your glutes at the top.

Name: Lunges
Setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your feet hip width apart and your core braced.
Execution: Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor until both knees are at roughly 90 degrees. Push through your front heel to return to standing and repeat on the other leg.

Name: Dumbbell RDL
Setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs with your feet hip width apart, knees slightly bent and shoulders pulled back.
Execution: Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs until your hamstrings are stretched, keeping your back flat. Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.

Name: Step-ups
Setup: Stand facing a sturdy bench or box with a dumbbell in each hand and one foot fully planted on top of it.
Execution: Drive through your front heel to step up until your leg is straight, then lower your trailing foot back down slowly. Keep the working leg doing the effort rather than pushing off the floor.

Name: Bulgarian Split Squats
Setup: Stand a stride length in front of a bench, rest the top of one foot behind you on it and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your torso slightly leaning forward.
Execution: Lower your back knee toward the floor until your front thigh is parallel to the ground. Drive through the front foot to stand up, keeping your front knee tracking over your toes.

Name: Front Squats
Setup: Rest the bar on your front shoulders with your elbows pointing forward and high, hands lightly gripping or crossed, feet shoulder width apart.
Execution: Sit straight down, keeping your torso upright and your elbows high until your thighs are at least parallel. Drive up through your feet, keeping the bar locked on your shoulders.

Name: Hip Thrust
Setup: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench, roll a padded barbell over your hips and plant your feet hip width apart with your knees bent.
Execution: Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is parallel to the floor and your shins are vertical. Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower under control without resting the bar on the floor.

Name: Barbell Lunges
Setup: Rest a barbell across your upper back, stand tall with your feet hip width apart and brace your core.
Execution: Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor until both knees reach about 90 degrees. Push off your front foot to return to the start and alternate legs.

Name: Barbell Calf Raises
Setup: Rest a barbell on your upper back, stand with the balls of your feet on a raised platform and your heels hanging off the edge.
Execution: Rise onto your toes as high as you can and squeeze your calves at the top. Lower your heels slowly until you feel a full stretch and repeat without bouncing.

Name: Shoulder Press Machine
Setup: Adjust the seat so the handles start at shoulder height, sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles with your feet planted.
Execution: Press the handles overhead until your arms are almost straight without shrugging. Lower them slowly back to shoulder height and press again.

Name: Reverse Pec Deck
Setup: Sit facing the pad of the pec deck, adjust the handles so your arms are straight in front of you at shoulder height and keep your chest against the pad.
Execution: Sweep your arms out and back with a soft bend in your elbows until they are in line with your shoulders. Squeeze your rear delts and return slowly without letting the weights touch.

Name: Machine Lateral Raises
Setup: Adjust the seat so the pads rest against your upper arms or elbows at shoulder level, sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles lightly.
Execution: Raise your arms out to the sides until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor. Lower slowly without letting the weight stack rest between reps.

Name: Cable Lateral Raises
Setup: Stand side-on to a low pulley with the handle in your far hand, take a small step away and keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Execution: Raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height, leading with your elbow, and pause briefly. Lower slowly so the cable keeps tension on your side delt the whole time.

Name: Face Pulls
Setup: Set a rope to upper chest or face height on a cable station, grab it with a thumbs-back grip and step back until your arms are extended.
Execution: Pull the rope toward your face, splitting the ends apart and driving your elbows high and wide. Squeeze your rear delts and upper back, then return slowly to full extension.

Name: Cable Front Raises
Setup: Stand facing away from a low pulley with the handle between your legs or at your side, holding it with a straight arm and a slight lean forward.
Execution: Raise your arm straight in front of you to shoulder height with your thumb up. Lower it slowly and keep your torso still to avoid swinging the weight.

Name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
Setup: Sit on a bench with back support, bring the dumbbells to shoulder height with your palms facing forward and your feet planted.
Execution: Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight and the weights nearly touch. Lower them slowly back to shoulder height and keep your ribs down so your lower back stays neutral.

Name: Dumbbell Front Raises
Setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in front of each thigh with your palms facing you, feet shoulder width apart and your core tight.
Execution: Raise the dumbbells straight in front of you to shoulder height with a soft bend in your elbows. Lower them slowly without swinging or leaning back.

Name: Rear Delt Flyes
Setup: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand, hinge forward until your torso is almost parallel to the floor with your arms hanging down and your back flat.
Execution: Raise your arms out to the sides until they are in line with your shoulders, squeezing your rear delts and upper back. Lower slowly without using momentum.

Name: Upright Row
Setup: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with a shoulder width overhand grip, stand tall and keep your core braced.
Execution: Pull the bar up along your body to chest height, leading with your elbows so they stay above your wrists. Lower it slowly to the start without letting your shoulders shrug excessively.

Name: Preacher Curl Machine
Setup: Adjust the seat so your armpits rest on top of the pad, hold the handles with an underhand grip and let your arms extend fully.
Execution: Curl the handles up toward your shoulders by squeezing your biceps without lifting your elbows from the pad. Lower slowly to a full stretch.

Name: Biceps Curl Machine
Setup: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine pivot, sit with your chest against the pad and take hold of the handles.
Execution: Curl the handles toward your shoulders, squeezing your biceps at the top. Return slowly until your arms are almost straight and repeat without swinging your torso.

Name: Cable Bicep Curl
Setup: Attach a straight or EZ bar to a low pulley, stand facing the machine with a shoulder width underhand grip and your elbows pinned to your sides.
Execution: Curl the bar up to shoulder height by flexing your biceps without moving your elbows. Lower it slowly until your arms are fully extended while the cable keeps tension on the muscle.

Name: Cable Hammer Curl
Setup: Attach a rope to a low pulley, grab it with your palms facing each other and stand tall with your elbows against your sides.
Execution: Curl the rope up toward your shoulders, keeping your wrists neutral and your elbows still. Lower it slowly until your arms are straight and squeeze your forearms and biceps at the top.

Name: Alternating Dumbbell Curls
Setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward, elbows close to your sides and your core braced.
Execution: Curl one dumbbell up to shoulder height while keeping your elbow still, then lower it slowly and curl the other arm. Alternate sides without swinging your body.

Name: Hammer Curls
Setup: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your palms facing your thighs and your elbows tucked in.
Execution: Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders, keeping your palms facing each other the whole way. Lower slowly to a full stretch and repeat without leaning back.

Name: Concentration Curls
Setup: Sit on a bench with your legs wide, hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh with your arm extended.
Execution: Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder by flexing your biceps, keeping your upper arm pinned to your leg. Squeeze at the top and lower slowly to full extension.

Name: Incline Dumbbell Curls
Setup: Set a bench to about 60 degrees, sit back with a dumbbell in each hand and let your arms hang straight down behind your torso.
Execution: Curl the dumbbells up without moving your upper arms forward. Squeeze your biceps at the top and lower slowly until your arms are fully stretched.

Name: EZ Bar Curls
Setup: Stand holding an EZ bar on its inner angled grips with your palms facing up, elbows tucked in and your chest up.
Execution: Curl the bar toward your shoulders without moving your elbows or swinging your torso. Lower the bar slowly until your arms are fully extended.

Name: EZ Bar Preacher Curls
Setup: Sit at a preacher bench with your armpits against the top of the pad, hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip and let your arms extend over the pad.
Execution: Curl the bar up until your forearms are almost vertical and squeeze your biceps. Lower slowly to a full stretch without letting your upper arms lift off the pad.

Name: Triceps Extension Machine
Setup: Adjust the seat so the handles start at a comfortable height, sit with your upper arms against the pad and grip the handles firmly.
Execution: Press the handles down or forward until your arms are fully straight and squeeze your triceps. Return slowly without letting your elbows drift away from the pad.

Name: Assisted Dips
Setup: Choose an assistance weight, kneel or stand on the platform and grip the dip handles with your arms extended and your torso slightly forward.
Execution: Lower your body until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor, keeping your elbows close to your sides. Press back up to straight arms and reduce the assistance as you get stronger.

Name: Triceps Pushdowns
Setup: Attach a straight bar or rope to a high pulley, stand close with a slight forward lean and pin your elbows to your sides.
Execution: Push the handle down until your arms are completely straight and squeeze your triceps. Return slowly until your forearms are just past parallel without letting your elbows move.

Name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
Setup: Attach a rope to a low or mid pulley, face away from the machine, hold the rope behind your head with your elbows pointing forward and take a staggered stance.
Execution: Extend your arms forward and up until they are straight, squeezing your triceps. Let the rope return behind your head slowly until you feel a stretch in the long head.

Name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
Setup: Sit or stand holding one dumbbell with both hands above your head, with your arms straight and your core braced.
Execution: Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping them pointing forward. Press back up until your arms are straight and your triceps are fully contracted.

Name: Triceps Kickbacks
Setup: Hold a light dumbbell, hinge forward with your back flat and your upper arm pinned against your side with your elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Execution: Extend your forearm back until your arm is straight and squeeze your triceps. Return slowly to the bent position without swinging your upper arm.

Name: Dumbbell Skullcrushers
Setup: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest with your palms facing each other and your arms straight.
Execution: Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells toward the sides of your head, keeping your upper arms still. Extend your elbows to press them back up until your arms are straight.

Name: EZ Bar Skullcrushers
Setup: Lie on a flat bench, hold an EZ bar with a close grip above your chest with your arms straight and your elbows pointing at the ceiling.
Execution: Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending only at the elbows. Extend your arms to return to the top, keeping your upper arms fixed in place.

Name: Close-Grip Bench Press
Setup: Lie on a flat bench with your eyes under the bar and grip it about shoulder width apart, with your shoulder blades pulled together and your feet planted.
Execution: Lower the bar to your lower chest with your elbows tucked close to your sides. Press it back up to lockout, focusing on driving through your triceps.

Name: Ab Crunch Machine
Setup: Adjust the seat and pads so the handles are near your chest, sit back with your feet secured and select a moderate weight.
Execution: Curl your torso forward and down by contracting your abs until your ribs move toward your hips. Return slowly to the start without letting the weight stack rest.

Name: Torso Rotation Machine
Setup: Adjust the seat and pads so your hips are fixed, grip the handles or rest your arms on the pads and start facing forward.
Execution: Rotate your torso to one side by contracting your obliques, hold briefly and return slowly. Complete all reps on one side, or alternate sides, without moving your hips.

Name: Cable Woodchoppers
Setup: Set a pulley to a high position, stand side-on to the machine with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the handle with both hands overhead.
Execution: Pull the handle diagonally down across your body toward the opposite hip by rotating through your torso. Return slowly under control, keeping your arms mostly straight.

Name: Dumbbell Side Bends
Setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in one hand at your side, your other hand lightly behind your head and your feet hip width apart.
Execution: Bend sideways toward the weight, lowering the dumbbell down your leg. Squeeze your oblique on the opposite side to return to upright without leaning forward or back.

Name: Russian Twists
Setup: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and your heels lifted or on the floor, lean back slightly and hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of your chest.
Execution: Rotate your torso to one side and tap the weight beside your hip, then rotate to the other side. Keep your chest up and move from your trunk rather than only your arms.

Name: Barbell Rollouts
Setup: Load a light barbell, kneel on a mat and grip the bar with your hands shoulder width apart, with your shoulders over the bar and your abs braced.
Execution: Roll the bar forward until your body is nearly straight, keeping your lower back from sagging. Pull the bar back to the start by contracting your abs.

Name: Landmine Twists
Setup: Anchor one end of a barbell in a landmine or corner, stand holding the free end with both hands at chest height and your feet shoulder width apart.
Execution: Rotate your torso and swing the bar from one side to the other in a controlled arc, pivoting your feet slightly. Keep your arms mostly straight and your core braced.

Name: Shoulder Shrugs
Setup: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Execution: Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as possible and squeeze your upper traps for a second. Lower them slowly without rolling your shoulders.

Name: Back Extensions
Setup: Set up on a back extension bench with your hips just off the pad and your feet secured, crossing your arms over your chest.
Execution: Lower your torso toward the floor by hinging at your hips, keeping your back flat. Raise it back up until your body forms a straight line, squeezing your glutes and lower back without overarching.

Name: Cable Rear Delt Flyes
Setup: Set two cable handles at shoulder height, cross them and grab the opposite handle in each hand, then step back with soft elbows and your arms straight in front of you.
Execution: Pull your arms apart until they are in line with your shoulders, squeezing your rear delts and upper back. Return slowly with the cables crossing in front of you.

Name: Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise
Setup: Sit at the edge of a bench holding light dumbbells, hinge forward until your chest is close to your thighs and let the dumbbells hang under your knees.
Execution: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides until your arms are in line with your shoulders, leading with your elbows. Lower slowly without using momentum.

Name: Single-Arm Cable Rear Delt Fly
Setup: Set a cable at shoulder height, hold the handle in the opposite hand across your body and lean slightly forward, with a soft bend in your elbow.
Execution: Sweep your arm across and out until it is in line with your shoulder, squeezing your rear delt. Return slowly under control and complete all reps before switching sides.

Name: Lying Incline Bench Rear Delt Raise
Setup: Set an incline bench to about 30 degrees, lie chest down on it with a light dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging straight down.
Execution: Raise the dumbbells out to the sides with your thumbs pointing up until your arms are in line with your shoulders. Lower slowly and keep your chest pressed against the pad.

Name: Arnold Press
Setup: Sit on a bench with back support, hold the dumbbells at chest height with your palms facing you and your elbows in front of your body.
Execution: Press the dumbbells up while rotating your palms to face forward as your arms straighten overhead. Reverse the rotation as you lower the weights back to chest height.

Name: Push Press
Setup: Rack the bar at your collarbone, grip just outside your shoulders, stand with your feet hip width apart and brace your core.
Execution: Dip slightly through your knees, then drive your legs up explosively and press the bar overhead to a locked-out finish. Lower the bar back to your shoulders and reset before the next rep.

Name: Landmine Press
Setup: Anchor one end of a barbell in a landmine or corner, hold the free end at your shoulder with one hand and stand in a staggered stance with your core braced.
Execution: Press the end of the bar up and forward until your arm is fully straight. Lower it slowly back to your shoulder and keep your ribs down throughout.

Name: Seated Barbell Shoulder Press
Setup: Set a bench with back support under a rack, sit with your feet flat and unrack the bar at collarbone height with a grip just outside your shoulders.
Execution: Press the bar straight overhead until your arms lock out, moving your head slightly back and through. Lower it under control to your collarbone and repeat.

Name: Cable Upright Row
Setup: Attach a straight bar or rope to a low pulley, stand close to the machine and grip with your hands about shoulder width apart.
Execution: Pull the handle up to chest height, leading with your elbows so they stay above your wrists. Lower it slowly until your arms are straight without leaning back.

Name: Dumbbell Upright Row
Setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs with your palms facing you and your core braced.
Execution: Lift the dumbbells up along your torso to chest height, keeping your elbows higher than your wrists. Lower them slowly to the starting position without swinging.

Name: Chin-ups
Setup: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip at shoulder width, arms fully extended, your core braced and legs slightly forward.
Execution: Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down until your chin clears it. Lower yourself under control until your arms are straight before the next rep.

Name: Inverted Rows
Setup: Set a bar at waist height in a rack, lie underneath it and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders, with your body straight and heels on the floor.
Execution: Pull your chest to the bar by driving your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades, keeping your body in a straight line. Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

Name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
Setup: Set an incline bench to about 30 degrees, lie chest down with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging straight toward the floor.
Execution: Row the dumbbells toward your hips by pulling your elbows back and squeezing your shoulder blades. Lower slowly to a full stretch without lifting your chest from the pad.

Name: Pendlay Row
Setup: Stand with the bar over your mid foot, hinge until your torso is parallel to the floor and grip the bar just outside your legs with a flat back.
Execution: Pull the bar explosively to your lower chest while keeping your torso still. Lower it back to the floor and reset your back position before every rep.

Name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
Setup: Attach a single handle to a high pulley, sit tall facing the machine or kneel with your torso upright and hold the handle with your arm extended overhead.
Execution: Pull the handle down toward your shoulder by driving your elbow to your side. Return slowly until your lat is fully stretched and finish all reps before switching sides.

Name: Rack Pulls
Setup: Set the safety pins in a power rack just below your knees, stand with the bar over your mid foot and grip it just outside your legs with a flat back.
Execution: Drive through your feet and extend your hips and knees to pull the bar to lockout, squeezing your upper back and glutes. Lower it under control back to the pins and reset.

Name: Barbell Shrugs
Setup: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with a shoulder width overhand grip, your arms straight and your core braced.
Execution: Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as possible and hold for a second. Lower slowly without rolling your shoulders or bending your elbows.

Name: Good Mornings
Setup: Rest a barbell on your upper back, stand with your feet shoulder width apart and keep a slight bend in your knees with your chest up.
Execution: Push your hips back and lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, keeping your back flat. Drive your hips forward to return to standing and squeeze your glutes.

Name: Cable Shrugs
Setup: Stand in front of a low pulley holding the bar or handles with your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Execution: Shrug your shoulders straight up as high as possible, hold briefly and squeeze your traps. Lower slowly so the cable keeps tension on the muscle.

Name: Push-ups
Setup: Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders on the floor and extend your legs behind you, with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Execution: Lower your chest to the floor by bending your elbows at about 45 degrees to your torso. Press back up until your arms are straight without letting your hips sag.

Name: Chest Dips
Setup: Grip the parallel bars, lift yourself to straight arms and lean your torso forward with your legs crossed or bent behind you.
Execution: Lower yourself until your upper arms are parallel to the floor or you feel a stretch in your chest. Press back up to straight arms while keeping the forward lean.

Name: Incline Chest Press Machine
Setup: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your upper chest, sit back against the pad with your feet planted and your shoulder blades squeezed together.
Execution: Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight. Return slowly until you feel a stretch across your upper chest and press again.

Name: Low-to-High Cable Flyes
Setup: Set both pulleys to the lowest position, hold a handle in each hand and step forward into a staggered stance with a slight forward lean.
Execution: Sweep your hands up and together in an arc until they meet in front of your upper chest. Lower slowly with a soft bend in your elbows until you feel a stretch.

Name: Smith Machine Bench Press
Setup: Place a flat bench under the bar, lie back with the bar over your mid chest, plant your feet and grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Execution: Unrack the bar and lower it to your mid chest under control. Press it back up to lockout and re-rack the bar by rotating your wrists when you finish.

Name: Svend Press
Setup: Hold two weight plates pressed together between your palms at chest height with your elbows pointing down and your feet shoulder width apart.
Execution: Press the plates straight out in front of you while squeezing them together as hard as possible. Pull them back to your chest slowly and keep the squeeze the whole time.

Name: Dumbbell Floor Press
Setup: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, with your upper arms resting on the floor and your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Execution: Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight above your chest. Lower them slowly until your triceps lightly touch the floor, pause briefly and press again.

Name: Spider Curls
Setup: Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees, lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging straight down.
Execution: Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders without letting your upper arms move. Squeeze your biceps at the top and lower slowly to full extension.

Name: Bayesian Curls
Setup: Set a handle on a low pulley, face away from the machine and take a step forward with your working arm pulled slightly behind your torso.
Execution: Curl the handle up toward your shoulder while keeping your elbow behind your body. Lower slowly until your biceps are fully stretched and repeat before switching arms.

Name: Zottman Curls
Setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward, elbows tucked in and your core braced.
Execution: Curl the dumbbells up with your palms facing up, rotate your wrists at the top so your palms face down and lower slowly. Rotate back to palms up at the bottom for the next rep.

Name: Reverse Barbell Curls
Setup: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip at shoulder width, your elbows pinned to your sides and your wrists straight.
Execution: Curl the bar up toward your shoulders while keeping your wrists neutral and your elbows still. Lower slowly until your arms are straight to work your forearms and brachialis.

Name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
Setup: Sit at a preacher bench with your armpit against the top of the pad, hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest your upper arm on the pad with your arm extended.
Execution: Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder without lifting your upper arm from the pad. Lower slowly to a full stretch and finish all reps before switching sides.

Name: Cross-Body Hammer Curls
Setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides with your palms facing your thighs and your elbows close to your body.
Execution: Curl one dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder with your palm facing in. Lower slowly and alternate arms while keeping your torso still.

Name: Drag Curls
Setup: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand shoulder width grip, your arms straight and your elbows close to your sides.
Execution: Curl the bar up by dragging it along your torso as your elbows move behind you. Lower it slowly along the same path to keep tension on your biceps.

Name: Bench Dips
Setup: Sit on the edge of a bench, place your hands beside your hips gripping the edge and walk your feet out until your hips are off the bench with your legs bent or straight.
Execution: Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor, keeping your back close to the bench. Press back up to straight arms.

Name: Diamond Push-ups
Setup: Get into a push-up position with your hands together under your chest so your thumbs and index fingers form a diamond, with your body in a straight line.
Execution: Lower your chest toward your hands, keeping your elbows close to your sides. Press back up until your arms are straight, squeezing your triceps at the top.

Name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
Setup: Attach a single handle to a high pulley, stand close with a slight forward lean and keep your working elbow pinned to your side.
Execution: Push the handle down until your arm is fully straight and squeeze your triceps. Return slowly until your forearm is just past parallel and finish all reps before switching sides.

Name: Reverse-Grip Tricep Pushdown
Setup: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley, grip it with an underhand shoulder width grip and stand close with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Execution: Push the bar down until your arms are straight, squeezing your triceps and keeping your wrists neutral. Let the bar rise slowly without moving your elbows.

Name: JM Press
Setup: Lie on a flat bench and unrack a barbell with a close grip, holding it above your chest with your arms straight and your elbows tucked in.
Execution: Lower the bar toward your upper chest or chin by bending your elbows and letting them travel forward. Press it back up to lockout, a hybrid between a skullcrusher and a close-grip press.

Name: Cable Triceps Kickbacks
Setup: Attach a handle to a low pulley, hinge forward with a flat back and hold the handle with your upper arm pinned beside your torso and your elbow bent.
Execution: Extend your forearm back until your arm is straight and squeeze your triceps. Return slowly to the bent position without moving your upper arm.

Name: Hack Squat
Setup: Step onto the machine platform with your back and shoulders against the pad, feet shoulder width apart and the safety handles released.
Execution: Lower your body by bending your knees until your thighs are at least parallel to the platform. Press through your feet to stand without locking your knees hard.

Name: Smith Machine Squats
Setup: Set the bar at upper chest height, step under it so it rests on your upper back and place your feet slightly in front of the bar at shoulder width.
Execution: Unrack the bar by rotating your wrists and sit down until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor. Drive through your feet to stand up, keeping your back flat.

Name: Sumo Deadlift
Setup: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out, with the bar over your mid foot, and grip the bar with your hands inside your knees with your chest up.
Execution: Push your knees out and drive through your feet to pull the bar up your legs until you stand tall. Lower it under control by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.

Name: Walking Lunges
Setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, stand tall with your feet together and your core braced.
Execution: Step forward with one leg and lower your back knee toward the floor until both knees reach 90 degrees. Push through your front foot to bring your back leg forward into the next lunge.

Name: Reverse Lunges
Setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your core braced.
Execution: Step one leg back and lower your back knee toward the floor until both knees are at about 90 degrees. Push through your front heel to return to standing and alternate legs.

Name: Seated Calf Raises
Setup: Sit at the machine with your knees under the pad and the balls of your feet on the platform with your heels hanging off.
Execution: Press up onto your toes as high as possible and squeeze your calves at the top. Lower your heels slowly to a full stretch before the next rep.

Name: Dumbbell Calf Raises
Setup: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand on a step or plate with the balls of your feet on the edge and your heels hanging off.
Execution: Rise onto your toes as high as possible and pause at the top. Lower your heels slowly until you feel a deep stretch in your calves.

Name: Nordic Hamstring Curls
Setup: Kneel on a pad with your ankles secured under a bar or held by a partner and your body upright from the knees up.
Execution: Lower your torso toward the floor as slowly as possible by extending your knees, keeping your hips straight. Catch yourself with your hands and push back up to the start.

Name: Glute Bridge
Setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip width apart and your arms by your sides.
Execution: Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders. Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower slowly.

Name: Cable Pull-Through
Setup: Attach a rope to a low pulley, face away from the machine, hold the rope between your legs and walk forward until the cable is under tension with your feet shoulder width apart.
Execution: Push your hips back until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor and the rope passes between your legs. Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes at the top.

Name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
Setup: Stand on one leg holding a dumbbell in the opposite hand with a slight bend in your standing knee and your core braced.
Execution: Hinge at your hips and extend your free leg straight behind you as the dumbbell lowers toward the floor. Return to standing by squeezing your glute and keeping your hips level.

Name: Sumo Squat
Setup: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out about 45 degrees, holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of you with your arms straight.
Execution: Sit down between your legs, keeping your knees pushing out over your toes and your torso upright. Drive through your feet to stand and squeeze your inner thighs and glutes.

Name: Hip Thrust Machine
Setup: Sit on the floor or seat of the machine with your upper back against the pad, adjust the belt over your hips and plant your feet hip width apart.
Execution: Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your torso is level with your thighs. Squeeze your glutes at the top and lower slowly without letting the weight rest.

Name: Glute Kickback Machine
Setup: Adjust the machine so your chest rests against the pad, place the back of one foot on the platform and hold the handles.
Execution: Press your foot back and up by squeezing your glute until your leg is extended. Return slowly without letting the weight touch down and complete all reps before switching legs.

Name: Hanging Leg Raises
Setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight and your legs together with your shoulders pulled down.
Execution: Raise your legs until they are parallel to the floor or higher by curling your pelvis toward your ribs. Lower them slowly without swinging your body.

Name: Hanging Knee Raises
Setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and your arms straight, with your shoulders pulled down and your legs together.
Execution: Raise your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis up. Lower your legs slowly under control and avoid swinging between reps.

Name: Ab Wheel Rollout
Setup: Kneel on a mat holding an ab wheel with both hands directly under your shoulders, with your back flat and your abs braced.
Execution: Roll the wheel forward as far as you can control while keeping your lower back from sagging. Pull the wheel back to the start by contracting your abs.

Name: Bicycle Crunches
Setup: Lie on your back with your hands lightly behind your head, lift your shoulders off the floor and raise your legs with your knees bent.
Execution: Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg straight, then switch sides in a pedaling motion. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor and move slowly.

Name: Dead Bug
Setup: Lie on your back with your arms pointing at the ceiling and your hips and knees bent to 90 degrees, pressing your lower back into the floor.
Execution: Lower your opposite arm and leg toward the floor while keeping your lower back flat. Return to the start and alternate sides at a slow, steady pace.

Name: Mountain Climbers
Setup: Start in a high plank position with your hands under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Execution: Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs quickly in a running motion. Keep your hips low and your core braced without bouncing your hips up.

Name: Side Plank
Setup: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder, stack your feet and lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Execution: Hold the position by squeezing your obliques and glutes without letting your hips drop. Breathe steadily and switch sides after your set time.

Name: Reverse Crunches
Setup: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides or holding a bench behind your head, with your knees bent over your hips.
Execution: Curl your hips off the floor by pulling your knees toward your chest using your lower abs. Lower slowly without swinging your legs.

Name: Decline Sit-ups
Setup: Lock your feet under the pads of a decline bench, lie back with your arms crossed over your chest or hands lightly behind your head.
Execution: Curl your torso up toward your knees by contracting your abs. Lower slowly until your back is nearly touching the bench and repeat without pulling on your neck.

Name: Pallof Press
Setup: Set a cable at chest height, stand side-on to the machine holding the handle with both hands at your chest and your feet shoulder width apart.
Execution: Press the handle straight out in front of you and hold for a second while resisting the cable pulling you around. Bring it back to your chest slowly and complete all reps before switching sides.

Name: Crunches
Setup: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat, with your hands lightly behind your head or crossed over your chest.
Execution: Curl your shoulders off the floor by contracting your abs, pausing briefly at the top. Lower slowly without pulling on your neck.

Name: Hanging Windshield Wipers
Setup: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, lift your legs to a horizontal position and keep your shoulders pulled down.
Execution: Rotate your legs from one side to the other in a controlled arc by twisting through your torso. Bring them back to the center and alternate sides without swinging.
